title: Flying in the Mall World
content: I just want to start with everytime I dream its obly in one of these spaces. Last time i had a dream it was in a very dystopian looking food court on a strange cruise ship. But heres the full Note i wrote as soon as i woke up last night from the "mall dream"; In todays dream, I started in ginormous depressing dark building, A building with booby traps and dark stair ways and hallways, similar to old new york buildings but older and darker. The building wasn’t a school, but there were people my age, even a few I remember, battling to make it to the top of the building, through the oldschool rundown stairwell but a few people would get stuck along the way. I made it to the top and was completely alone, and noticed people walking by me, On the roof there were many storage looking doors, but one of them specifically caught my eye, I opened the door and it’s the department store always dream about but in the store I instantly feel off, as if I don’t belong there and I’m gonna get In trouble. At first the store and the people in it seem okay, then I realize I can’t recognize anything and the people, everything feels off. I run outside the store into the mall and these mall security guards start chasing me, so I activate my floating capabilities and I start flying through the mall. It wasn’t a high speed chase, it was more like I floated to the ceiling of the building and was slowly swimming through the air trying to get away, yet anytime i looked behind me, they were chasing me doing the same thing. I hit a few boosts buttons, which I had for some reason, and it gave me just enough time to cut a corner and lose security and turn into another being and just sit in middair and watch the vast hallways. I also had girls on the floor chasing me and yelling at me but I forgot why they were there. This dream also felt connected to a theater dream ive had. The most confusing part of this dream to me is the door on the roof to the mall. Why is it that everytime I have the mall dream, i start somewhere random and enter a door that leads me to the mall, and it feels completely unsettling. It feels like I’m entering an alien space and that I severely stand out, like they could tell I’m dreaming and they wanna come at me for it. This might be a response to My Social Anxiety. But literally everytime im in "the mall" i get this feeling like im at the place where things will be found, an important place, and then i wake up.
